P_DIAGONAL_DEFECT_NONDEGENERATE.rule: min_{n<=8}|D_n|/max_{n<=8}|D_n| >= 1e-3 at every cell and does not decrease by more than a factor 10 between m=13 and m=163

P_LATTICE_IDENTITIES_EXACT.rule: all LATTICE-1/2 residuals <= 1e-30 relative at every cell
P_LATTICE_IDENTITIES_EXACT.worst_relative_residual_note: float mirror; values below ~1e-324 underflow to 0.0 -- the exact magnitudes are the per-cell decimal strings

P_TAIL_COUPLING_IS_LEADING.rule: |rho_n(floor L)|/|D_n y_n| >= 1 for n = 1..3 at every cell
